claims.text: The source defines Voicebox: flow-matching infilling speech model (non-autoregressive continuous normalising flow with optimal-transport conditional flow matching, Transformer vector field on 80-dim log-mel plus frame-aligned phones) plus duration model, infill conditioning on past+future audio+text, classifier-free guidance, ODE solver under 10 evaluations; external HiFi-GAN-class vocoder.

Reported numbers: zero-shot vs VALL-E word-error-rate 5.9% to 1.9%, similarity 0.580 to 0.681, up to 20x faster; cross-lingual vs YourTTS WER 10.9% to 5.2%, similarity 0.335 to 0.481; denoise vs prior work −8.8% WER, +0.450 similarity, +0.80 MOS.

limitations.text: Needs forced alignments/phone transcripts; vocoder-dependent; detailed §5 tables truncated in fetch.
